subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core shell-facing admin notification surface for connected Control UI sessions, and should that surface be a live Gateway UI event, Web Push reuse, or a plugin/ClawHub extension point?
rationale: The feature is absent, but it creates new user-visible interruption behavior and a security-sensitive admin authority path rather than repairing an existing contract.

options.title: Approve a core admin notification contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the focused tracker and require the CLI, Gateway, UI, and security tests to implement one typed notification path.

options.title: Fold into broader WebUI notifications
options.body: Make the broader notification-system tracker own the UI/toast design and keep this issue only as the shell/admin broadcast requirement.

options.title: Route optional alerts to plugins
options.body: Reject a new core command unless a missing plugin API is identified, and document the supported external or plugin-owned path instead.

recommendation.title: Approve a core admin notification contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the focused tracker and require the CLI, Gateway, UI, and security tests to implement one typed notification path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current central-file blame points to this person across the CLI/Gateway/UI surfaces that would need coordinated product and security review, though the history is a broad materialization commit.
